column2: Extended autonomous work mode: inspects the project, then implements, tests and commits for hours, stopping only for irreversible decisions.
Turns a React + PostgreSQL web app into a premium Expo iOS/Android app (audit, design system, exams, server guards, APK, stores), then keeps building it in autonomous mode.
Redesigns one existing page for the best UX: captures it, keeps a contract of what it must still do, rebuilds it in your stack, checks the real render at three widths.

Finds a free, legally usable image for a blog article across Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, Openverse and Wikimedia, downloads it as WebP with its credit line, never reuses one; CLI and HTTP API for pipelines.
Shields an nginx server from distributed scrapers: reads the logs, finds the networks a bot rotates its addresses through, closes them at Cloudflare; never a search engine or an access provider.

Keeps a project moving across several sessions, e.g. every night: relaunches autonomous-mode from a plan.md in its own worktree and branch, judges each session itself (commits, plan untouched, no deleted test, clean tree, check still green), never pushes or merges.

Writes a series of long reference pages (trades, cities, procedures) where every legal or number claim points to a primary source, written per item never from a template, held by a deterministic floor check.

Produces client-ready Word and PDF documents (reports, proposals, specifications, audits, roadmaps) from a Markdown source: cover, paged contents, key figures, styled tables, themed figures, page-by-page review before delivery.
Keeps a Linux server's disk under control without touching data: nightly, emergency and weekly passes, spares caches in use, proves each pass; root or no root.

Stops false completion: a frozen acceptance contract written before the code, receipts written by a script (exit code, output, working-tree fingerprint), stale and gamed proofs detected, an independent checker, and a computed verdict DONE / NOT DONE / BLOCKED; optional Stop hook.

Gives a web app the Espresso look (frappe-ui, ERPNext): drop-in kit for Next.js + Tailwind 4 + shadcn on Base UI with tokens, 40 components, sidebar shell, style guide page, an apply script that never overwrites silently, a brand contrast check and a build self-test; tokens and rules for other stacks.

Walks a periodic, read-only security round on a Linux server: 40 native checks (SSH, exposed databases, Docker bypassing UFW, secrets in clear, root jobs another account can modify, patches, backups) plus Lynis, Trivy and Gitleaks when present; scored report with one fix per finding and the delta since the last round; never changes the server.
